_readme: Other places money hides: loyalty programs, store price adjustments, unclaimed money, library perks, refund rules and use-it-or-lose-it deadlines.
Same rule as the card catalog: official sources only. status "active" needs source_url and last_verified; anything we couldn't confirm stays TODO_VERIFY and says so in its summary.
countries: where it applies (empty = anywhere). merchants: lowercase store names a receipt's merchant must contain (price_adjust and loyalty). window_days: days after purchase (price_adjust).

programs.name: American Airlines AAdvantage
programs.summary: Miles expire after 24 months with no earning or redeeming. Primary AAdvantage credit cardmembers keep them while the card is open.
programs.how_to: Earn or redeem at least once every 24 months — even a small purchase with a partner counts.

programs.name: Marriott Bonvoy
programs.summary: Points are forfeited after 24 months with no earning or redeeming, and can't be reinstated.
programs.how_to: Earn or redeem at least once every two years.

programs.name: Hilton Honors
programs.summary: Points expire after 24 months with no qualifying activity (a stay, card earning, a partner, or buying or donating points).
programs.how_to: Do one qualifying activity every 24 months.

programs.name: Starbucks Rewards
programs.summary: Free to join. A free birthday drink or food item (make one Star-earning purchase first). Green-level Stars expire after 6 months.
programs.how_to: A Star-earning purchase, a reward redemption or a $30+ digital reload in the month before pushes expiry back a month.

programs.name: Caribbean Miles
programs.summary: Caribbean Airlines' miles program. We couldn't confirm when miles expire — check your account and add the date here.
programs.how_to: Log in to Caribbean Miles to see your balance and any expiry date.

programs.name: Massy Card
programs.summary: Points at Massy Stores and partners (1 point per TT$10 at launch). We couldn't confirm if or when points expire.
programs.how_to: Check your balance in the Massy Card app or on your receipt, and add it here with any expiry date.

programs.name: Target price match
programs.summary: If Target lowers the price of an identical item within 14 days of your purchase, it refunds the difference. Clearance is excluded.
programs.how_to: Bring the receipt to a store, or call 1-800-591-3869 for Target.com orders. Screenshots aren't accepted — show the live price.

programs.name: Best Buy price match
programs.summary: If Best Buy lowers its price during your return and exchange period, it matches the lower price on request — more than once. Open-box and clearance are excluded.
programs.how_to: Online orders: chat or call 1-888-237-8289. Store purchases: Customer Service desk.

programs.name: Costco price adjustment
programs.summary: If the price drops within 30 days of purchase, members can get the difference back. Costco can deny requests at its discretion.
programs.how_to: Costco.com orders: the price adjustment form online. Warehouse purchases: the returns counter where you bought it.

programs.name: Macy's price adjustment
programs.summary: If an eligible item's advertised price drops within 10 days of your order, Macy's refunds the difference. Clearance and some items are excluded.
programs.how_to: Request it from Macy's customer service; it goes back to your original payment method.

programs.name: Unclaimed money (US states)
programs.summary: Forgotten bank balances, refunds, deposits and insurance payouts held by states. Searching is free.
programs.how_to: Search your name on MissingMoney.com, plus your state's own site. Never pay a finder to search.

programs.name: Unclaimed government bond payments
programs.provider: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago
programs.summary: Unpaid interest and maturity payments on government bonds, treasury bills and notes. The Central Bank publishes the names.
programs.how_to: Check the list, then call the Government Services Unit at 621-2288 or 235-2288.

programs.name: Unclaimed bank balances
programs.provider: Ministry of Finance and the Public Service
programs.summary: Accounts untouched for 15+ years are published twice a year. Claim at your bank within a year of publication, then from the Accountant General.
programs.how_to: Search the latest list on the Ministry's publications page, then contact the bank named.

programs.name: Dormant bank balances
programs.summary: Balances inactive for years are moved to the Central Bank for safekeeping until the owner claims them.
programs.how_to: Ask the bank where you held the account — it makes the claim with the Central Bank for you.

programs.name: Inactive bank accounts
programs.summary: Banks publish lists of long-inactive accounts before unclaimed money goes to the Central Bank of Barbados. We couldn't find an official searchable list.
programs.how_to: Ask any bank where you've had an account whether you're on its inactive-accounts list.

programs.name: Libby
programs.summary: Free e-books and audiobooks from your public library. No fees, no late fees.
programs.how_to: Install Libby, find your library and add your library card.

programs.name: Kanopy
programs.summary: Free films and documentaries through participating libraries and universities.
programs.how_to: Find your library on Kanopy and sign in with your library card.

programs.name: NALIS library card
programs.summary: Free for residents: e-books and audiobooks on Libby, popular magazines on Flipster and EBSCO research databases.
programs.how_to: Register online, collect your card at a branch, then set your PIN for the digital library.

programs.name: Jamaica Library Service
programs.summary: Free computers and internet at 119 libraries; members can use EBSCO research databases.
programs.how_to: Join at any parish or branch library.

programs.name: Cancelled or very late US flights
programs.summary: Flights to, from or within the US: if it's cancelled or delayed 3+ hours (domestic) or 6+ hours (international) and you don't accept another option, you're owed a cash refund — within 7 business days for card payments.
programs.how_to: Decline the rebooking or credit if you want the money back. If it doesn't arrive, file a complaint with the DOT.

programs.name: Delayed or cancelled flights in Europe
programs.summary: Flights leaving the EU, or into the EU on an EU airline: €250–€600 compensation when you arrive 3+ hours late or a late cancellation, unless the airline proves extraordinary circumstances.
programs.how_to: Claim from the airline first; each EU country has a body that handles complaints.

programs.name: Charged twice or for something you never got
programs.summary: US credit cards: dispute billing errors in writing within 60 days of the statement that first shows them. You don't have to pay the disputed amount while it's investigated.
programs.how_to: Call your card issuer, then send a letter to its billing-inquiries address.

programs.name: Health FSA: use it or lose it
programs.summary: Money left in a health FSA at the end of the plan year is lost, unless your plan has a grace period (up to 2½ months) or a carryover (up to $680 for 2026) — never both.
programs.how_to: Check your plan's deadline and add your balance here so PerkScan reminds you.

programs.name: Sephora Beauty Insider
programs.summary: Free to join. A birthday gift every year (no purchase in store; $25 minimum online), plus 1 point per $1.
programs.how_to: Join in the Sephora app or at sephora.com and add your birthday.

programs.name: Ulta Beauty Rewards
programs.summary: Free to join. A free birthday gift with a qualifying purchase and double points in your birthday month; 100 points = $3 off.
programs.how_to: Join at ulta.com, add your birthday and opt in to emails before your birthday month.

programs.name: Chipotle Rewards
programs.summary: Free to join. 10 points per $1 and a free birthday reward (guac, queso, chips or a drink).
programs.how_to: Join in the Chipotle app and add your birthday.

programs.name: MyPanera
programs.summary: Free to join. A free bakery treat for your birthday, no purchase needed.
programs.how_to: Join MyPanera and add your birthday to your account.

programs.name: Dunkin' Rewards
programs.summary: Free to join. 10 points per $1, rewards from 150 points, and 3X points around your birthday.
programs.how_to: Join in the Dunkin' app and add your birthday.

programs.name: AMC Stubs Insider
programs.summary: Free to join. A free large popcorn in your birthday month (after a month of membership).
programs.how_to: Join at amctheatres.com/amcstubs and add your birthday.

programs.name: CVS ExtraCare
programs.summary: Free. 2% back in ExtraBucks Rewards on qualifying purchases and a $3 birthday reward.
programs.how_to: Join at cvs.com/extracare, add your birthday and turn on notifications 4 weeks before.

programs.name: Target Circle
programs.summary: Free. Deals applied at checkout and 5% off a purchase for your birthday (use it within 30 days).
programs.how_to: Join Target Circle and add your birth date before your birthday.

programs.name: Museums on Us
programs.summary: Free general admission at participating museums the first full weekend of every month for Bank of America cardholders.
programs.how_to: Show your Bank of America card and a photo ID at a participating museum.

programs.name: Amex Offers
programs.summary: Statement credits at stores and restaurants: add an offer to your card, then pay with that card.
programs.how_to: Open Offers in the Amex app and tap "Add to Card" before you buy.

programs.name: Chase Offers
programs.summary: Cash back at stores and restaurants: add an offer to your card in the Chase app, then pay with that card.
programs.how_to: Open Chase Offers in the Chase app and add offers before you buy.

programs.name: Capital One Offers
programs.summary: Cash back or miles when you shop through an offer you activate with your Capital One card.
programs.how_to: Pick an offer in the Capital One app and shop from its link with the same card.

programs.name: Citi Merchant Offers
programs.summary: Statement credits from offers you enroll in, plus Citi Shop for online stores.
programs.how_to: Enroll in offers in your Citi account, then pay with that card.

programs.name: National park fee-free days
programs.summary: Free entrance to national parks on 8 days a year for US residents (2026: Nov 11, Veterans Day, is next). Camping and other fees still apply.
programs.how_to: Check the dates and go: no sign-up needed.

programs.name: IRS Free File
programs.summary: File your federal taxes free with guided software if your 2025 income (AGI) was $89,000 or less; free fillable forms for anyone.
programs.how_to: Start at irs.gov/freefile, not on a tax company’s own site.
